coverage: The production index loads the byte-identical LOCK 95 V1 pack. The twelve runtime prerequisites match the fountain after values in Q54. The test uses staged earlier progress for the towns and exercises Jisra’s built visit flag.

Each town requires both met_teacher and its own locked prerequisite. Every group offers one Name at a time, in order, and rejects dispatch of a later Name. The button disappears after the eighth confirmation.

Each of the 96 rendered scenes uses the town kicker, transliteration title, location, Arabic, meaning and Idris’s line in locked order. Escape returns to the same hub without learning and leaves the same Name available.
Confirming learns one unique Name and records completion. Retrying the old choice, saving and reloading preserve the count and order. The three River Market Names still learn on opening.
The private Journal uses the existing Names of Allah learned goal, reaches 99 / 99, and leaves other rows, coins, trust and clock unchanged. A new game clears learned Names.
